title.zh: 【DRW 与 Marex 在 Canton 完成引用代币化标普 iBoxx 指数的场外互换交易】
title.en: 【DRW 与 Marex 在 Canton 完成引用代币化标普 iBoxx 指数的场外互换交易】

current_state.zh: DRW and Marex executed the first OTC total return swap on Canton Network, referencing Kaiko's tokenized S&P iBoxx USD Liquid Investment Grade Index, with smart-contract-based lifecycle and valuation management and plans to link positions to digital cash and collateral.
